text: In an erbium-doped fiber amplifier the erbium metastable (upper-level) lifetime is about ___ milliseconds, slow enough that the amplifier shows transient gain excursions when WDM channels are added or dropped.
explanation: The ~10 ms upper-level lifetime makes EDFA gain dynamics slow, causing transient surviving-channel power swings during add/drop events. This slow response is why EDFAs need gain-control loops in reconfigurable networks.
